title: Fezzycraft
description: FezzyCraft SMP is a friendly Minecraft survival server featuring community events, creative builds, and minigames.
body: **FezzyCraft SMP is a survival server where we focus on playing together rather than just doing our own thing. We use a whitelist to keep griefers out so you don't worry about your builds. We run events and minigames every week, plus seasonal stuff.
